blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 19, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court resumes Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, with the defense set to present four government officials as witnesses.

On Day 44, the proceedings will test whether the defense can address the prosecution’s allegations of P817.17 million in unexplained wealth, questionable business transactions involving a company linked to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, and Duterte’s financial disclosures.
WATCH: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 19, 2026

items: The witnesses are former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) investigator Rainer Dela Fuente, Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo, Food and Drug Administration Director IV Pilar Marilyn Pagayunan, and Center for International Expositions and Missions (Citem) department manager Rowena Mendoza.
The witnesses are expected to discuss financial investigation rules, company registration and business transactions involving Cale88 Food Corp., allegedly partly owned by Carpio.

The prosecution maintains that Duterte and Carpio accumulated at least P817.17 million in unexplained wealth. Forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera’s broader assessment indicated that potentially undisclosed assets could exceed P1.5 billion.
The defense previously presented explanations involving a P205,007 dinner in Tokyo, Japan, and a P256,882.50 Nike shoe purchase in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, both charged to Carpio’s credit card./dp
